## How to play

Each mission has five notes and room for only five context slots. Pick the facts the next tool call needs, then run it. A correct pair advances the trajectory; irrelevant notes consume space. The slot costs are simplified game units.

## The systems concept

An agent's context is an active working set. When a long trajectory must be compacted, preserving the evidence and authority needed by the next action matters more than retaining every earlier sentence. The game makes that selection visible as a budget decision.
